command: lake build VE.Discourse.PositionsExamples (each bug planted alone in lean/VE/Discourse/Positions.lean at df175a622, then restored; line numbers are that commit's). The tool's mutants of every new or changed trusted definition are trust-mutants.json.

mutants.to: ms.any fun o => o.span != m.span && o.span.1 ≤ m.span.1 && m.span.2 ≤ o.span.2
mutants.test: lean/VE/Discourse/PositionsExamples.lean:170 (a pronoun inside a plural's span, no slot: MentionNotSlot); also :177, :179, :182, :184-188
mutants.note: the plural-span #guard, the task's first seeded bug

mutants.test: lean/VE/Discourse/PositionsExamples.lean:164 (the possessive inside the definite's restriction accepted); also :165-167
mutants.note: the definite-restriction #guard, the task's second seeded bug

mutants.mutant: the encloser may have any form
mutants.from: o.form == .definite && m.form == .possessive && o.span != m.span && o.span.1 ≤ m.span.1 && m.span.2 ≤ o.span.2 &&
mutants.to: m.form == .possessive && o.span != m.span && o.span.1 ≤ m.span.1 && m.span.2 ≤ o.span.2 &&
mutants.test: lean/VE/Discourse/PositionsExamples.lean:179 (a possessive inside a demonstrative with a relational restriction recorded)

mutants.mutant: the nested mention may have any form
mutants.from: o.form == .definite && m.form == .possessive && o.span != m.span && o.span.1 ≤ m.span.1 && m.span.2 ≤ o.span.2 &&
mutants.to: o.form == .definite && o.span != m.span && o.span.1 ≤ m.span.1 && m.span.2 ≤ o.span.2 &&

mutants.mutant: the same span counts as nested
mutants.from: o.form == .definite && m.form == .possessive && o.span != m.span && o.span.1 ≤ m.span.1 && m.span.2 ≤ o.span.2 &&
mutants.to: o.form == .definite && m.form == .possessive && o.span.1 ≤ m.span.1 && m.span.2 ≤ o.span.2 &&
mutants.test: lean/VE/Discourse/PositionsExamples.lean:194 (the possessive on the definite's own span)

mutants.mutant: the start of the span is not checked
mutants.from: o.form == .definite && m.form == .possessive && o.span != m.span && o.span.1 ≤ m.span.1 && m.span.2 ≤ o.span.2 &&
mutants.to: o.form == .definite && m.form == .possessive && o.span != m.span && m.span.2 ≤ o.span.2 &&

mutants.mutant: the end of the span is not checked
mutants.from: o.form == .definite && m.form == .possessive && o.span != m.span && o.span.1 ≤ m.span.1 && m.span.2 ≤ o.span.2 &&
mutants.to: o.form == .definite && m.form == .possessive && o.span != m.span && o.span.1 ≤ m.span.1 && true &&

mutants.mutant: the target is ignored: any relational restriction exempts
mutants.from: | some (.binary _ (.var 0) (.const c)) => termConst m.target == some c
mutants.test: lean/VE/Discourse/PositionsExamples.lean:186 (another target than the restriction's argument) and :187 (a binder target)

mutants.mutant: the restriction argument position is not read: any first term
mutants.from: | some (.binary _ (.var 0) (.const c)) => termConst m.target == some c
mutants.to: | some (.binary _ _ (.const c)) => termConst m.target == some c
